target_statement: Test primitive beta dominance of the full rank1 nilpotent long-top source with nonconstant transverse affine g, using one exact full first-jet differential.
implication_to_classification: Rank16 proves an actual nonreduced-divisor source dominates the full primitive base, requiring revised generic exhaustion. Rank below16 only identifies a candidate kernel to be proved globally; it is not non-dominance.
coefficient_ring: QQ[a,b,c,k0,...,k5] with all20 affine orbit directions and scale; all30 zero/first jet entries and all4 perspective gauge directions
hypotheses: Full normalized source g=z, U=az d_z+(b+cz)d_w, K arbitrary quadratic, r=y-x^2/2. The original six brackets from the full rank1 source are retained and their universal Jacobi, modular field and Pfaffian are checked before evaluation.
inverted_elements: Pf at the single declared basepoint (0,0,1,0)
complements: g constant or zero are separate full-source branches
No higher formal jet is calculated
A pointwise small rank is not used as a generic upper bound
success_certificate: All universal original-coordinate brackets and Jacobi; exact30x34 combined jet matrix with full constant-evaluation and perspective matrices; QQ minors and kernels, and the equivalent fixed-value quotient rank.
independent_check: A separate reader reconstructs the full source and primitive quotient; any rank16 claim requires an independently multiplied nonzero minor.
negative_result_next_step: If the rank is below16, inspect the same exact kernel and derive an all-source actual fiber or invariant; no repeated source-point probe and no higher-jet loop.
